transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Morgan, the Live-Events Producer. Before I can approve the final effects plan and we can get the stage plot and production certificate issued, I need to review the plan with both the special-effects coordinator and the insurance coordinator at our production sign-off meeting. Who's ready to walk me through where we stand?
